# EdgeWeb

> EdgeWeb is a full-stack technology solutions company based in India, building custom websites, software, AI automation, and digital growth systems for businesses in the USA, Europe, Australia and India.

EdgeWeb was founded in 2019 and works remote-first with early-stage teams and established businesses across retail, financial services and healthcare. Typical engagements run 6–16 weeks, delivered in phases so a working system ships early rather than one large release at the end.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://www.edgeweb.co/services/web-development): Corporate and high-performance websites, web applications, CRM/ERP portals and dashboards.
- [App Development](https://www.edgeweb.co/services/app-development): iOS, Android, cross-platform and React Native apps, from MVP to full product.
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.edgeweb.co/services/custom-software): Enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, internal tools, and legacy system modernization.
- [AI & Automation](https://www.edgeweb.co/services/ai-automation): AI agents and chatbots, workflow automation, CRM/lead/WhatsApp automation, data pipelines and API integrations.
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.edgeweb.co/services/digital-marketing): SEO, technical SEO, local SEO, performance marketing, content marketing, and conversion rate optimization.
- [Branding & UI/UX](https://www.edgeweb.co/services/branding-ui-ux): Brand strategy, logo and visual identity, UI/UX and product design, design systems.
- [Low-Code / No-Code](https://www.edgeweb.co/services/low-code-no-code): Rapid MVPs, internal tools, workflow systems and automation platforms.
- [Custom Solutions](https://www.edgeweb.co/services/custom-solutions): Custom CRM/ERP, dashboards, booking systems, portals and data platforms.
